title: Omarchy – Linux that is capitalizing on AI momentum
excerpt: Omarchy is not a distro, but that's not worth nitpicking about.
content_html:
Omarchy is not a distro, but that's not worth nitpicking about.

I have no problem with Omarchy, save one: it seems to (ironically) create a walled-in Linux environment that requires giving up a fair amount of control for a (lengthy) bespoke list of stuff.

This is mainly apparent with updates; if you install Omarchy, you have to update via Omarchy or risk some mayhem, you use DHH's separate package repo, etc. I'm simplifying, but that's the gist.

This seems to go against most of the reasons I like Linux.
